case_definitions.encode: canonical source-derived message encodes to expected bytes
case_definitions.decode: expected bytes decode with the declared message type
case_definitions.malformed: truncated or invalid wire input is rejected
case_definitions.unknown_field: well-formed unknown fields are accepted and do not alter known values
case_definitions.any: Any type URL is type.googleapis.com/<fully-qualified-name> and value bytes are canonical
case_definitions.map_order: logical map equality is independent of encoded entry order; canonical fixture order is explicit
case_definitions.presence: absent versus explicitly encoded default is covered where wire presence is observable
case_definitions.size: encoded byte count is asserted before size-sensitive hashing or transport
